hypothesis: A fixed smooth ridge objective yields numerically adequate kernel comparisons and clarifies whether landmark compression itself loses useful ranking information.
label_encoding: -1/+1; training mean is the intercept; centered squared-error loss
kernel_normalization: training-only center and unit average squared feature norm
interpretation: No ridge/angle/depth tuning. Both seed groups use the same frozen conditions and gates, reported separately.
